meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps: my cart (three items with quantities), a shipping form (name, address, city, postcode, email, all checked, with messages under the fields), then a payment summary with a choice of standard or express delivery changing the total, and a confirmation screen with an order number. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
state step=1
state q1=1
state q2=1
state q3=2
state name=""
state address=""
state city=""
state postcode=""
state email=""
state delivery="standard"
state tried=false
state p1=12
state p2=8
state p3=25
state ship=5
Card w:390 gap:12
  Row between middle
    Text.title "Checkout"
    Text.muted "Step {min(step,3)} of 3"
  Progress value:=min(step,3)/3
  Divider
  if step==1
    Column gap:12
      Text.heading "My cart"
      Row middle gap:8
        Column grow
          Text.strong "Linen shirt"
          Text.muted "${p1} each"
        Button.outline "-" -> q1=max(0,q1-1)
        Text.strong "{q1}"
        Button.outline "+" -> q1=q1+1
      Row middle gap:8
        Column grow
          Text.strong "Canvas tote"
          Text.muted "${p2} each"
        Button.outline "-" -> q2=max(0,q2-1)
        Text.strong "{q2}"
        Button.outline "+" -> q2=q2+1
      Row middle gap:8
        Column grow
          Text.strong "Leather belt"
          Text.muted "${p3} each"
        Button.outline "-" -> q3=max(0,q3-1)
        Text.strong "{q3}"
        Button.outline "+" -> q3=q3+1
      Divider
      Row between
        Text "Subtotal"
        Text.strong "${q1*p1+q2*p2+q3*p3}"
      if q1+q2+q3>0
        Button "Continue to shipping" -> tried=false; step=2
      if q1+q2+q3==0
        Text.danger "Your cart is empty."
  if step==2
    Column gap:10
      Text.heading "Shipping"
      Input "Full name" "Jane Doe" =name
      if tried&&len(name)<2
        Text.danger "Please enter your full name."
      Input "Address" "12 High Street" =address
      if tried&&len(address)<5
        Text.danger "Please enter your street address."
      Input "City" "London" =city
      if tried&&len(city)<2
        Text.danger "Please enter your city."
      Input "Postcode" "AB1 2CD" =postcode
      if tried&&len(postcode)<4
        Text.danger "Please enter a valid postcode."
      Input "Email" "you@example.com" =email
      if tried&&!contains(email,"@")
        Text.danger "Please enter a valid email address."
      if !tried
        Text.muted "All fields are required."
      Row gap:8
        Button.outline "Back" -> step=1
        Spacer grow
        Button "Continue to payment" -> tried=true
      if len(name)>=2&&len(address)>=5&&len(city)>=2&&len(postcode)>=4&&contains(email,"@")
        Button.secondary "Details look good: proceed" -> step=3
  if step==3
    Column gap:10
      Text.heading "Payment summary"
      Row between
        Text "Items"
        Text "${q1*p1+q2*p2+q3*p3}"
      Text.strong "Delivery"
      Row gap:8
        ChoiceChip "Standard ($5)" -> delivery="standard"; ship=5
        ChoiceChip "Express ($15)" -> delivery="express"; ship=15
      Row between
        Text "Shipping"
        Text "${ship}"
      Divider
      Row between
        Text.heading "Total"
        Text.heading "${q1*p1+q2*p2+q3*p3+ship}"
      Text.muted "Ship to {name}, {address}, {city} {postcode}"
      Row gap:8
        Button.outline "Back" -> step=2
        Spacer grow
        Button "Pay now" -> step=4; emit order
  if step==4
    Column gap:10 center
      Icon "check_circle"
      Text.title "Order confirmed"
      Text.strong "Order number: #48213907"
      Text.muted "A receipt was sent to {email}."
      Text.muted "Delivery: {delivery}"

delta: Please enter a valid email address
